row:
Tailored Techniques for Happier, Healthier Horses. 

At The Equine Collaborative, we are dedicated to empowering equestrians to enhance their horses' well-being through self-directed bodywork. For a small monthly fee, our members gain access to a comprehensive library of instructional videos focused on equine massage, bodywork techniques, saddle fitting, and overall health maintenance. Our goal is to equip horse owners with the knowledge and skills they need to improve their horses comfort, performance,  and strengthen the partnership. Join us in our mission to elevate the care and understanding of our equine companions, in the most accessible way yet!
